lesson-ledger with authority ladder CANDIDATE < VERIFIED_LOCAL < CONDITIONALLY_REUSABLE < PROOF_BACKED, SUPERSEDED = lineage
consolidated-view (defeasible derived view, never the canonical memory root)

transition_semantics: fast loop: action -> observation -> frozen TaskEpisode, strictly before interpretation; slow loop: episodes -> contrastive analysis -> lesson proposal -> replay/transfer validation -> scoped method update
